import Mathlib

example (n : ℕ) : Even (n * (n + 1)) := by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with h | h
  · exact h.mul_right (n + 1)
  · exact h.add_one.mul_left n

example (n : ℕ) : n ≤ 5 ∨ n ≥ 6 := by
  by_cases h : n ≤ 5
  · left
    exact h
  · right
    omega
